description: This file defines a utility class Overflow64Counter for tracking a 64-bit global CPU cycle count based on the 32-bit CYCCNT register in STM32F4 hardware. It includes methods to update and maintain a 64-bit counter by handling overflows of the hardware cycle counter.

classes.name: Overflow64Counter
classes.description: A class to manage a 64-bit cycle count based on a 32-bit hardware register, handling overflows and providing a high-level counter.

methods.name: Overflow64Counter()
methods.description: Constructor initializing the high and low bits of the counter.

methods.name: void updateAndSet(State64 * state,uint32_t value)
methods.description: Updates the counter state with a new 32-bit value, handling overflow by incrementing high bits.

methods.name: efitime_t update(uint32_t value)
methods.description: Updates the internal counter state and returns the combined 64-bit value; available only in unit test builds.
